facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Mozambique recently tendered a mobile ID and digital signature infrastructure project.
facts.system: mobile ID and digital signature infrastructure project

MOZ.note: No link between civil register and ID is described.
Gives cards issued in H1 2026 (856,101), not people enrolled or a share of the population.
No number at birth is mentioned.
States DNIC issues the cards but not who operates or maintains the platform.
No public register using the ID number is mentioned.

facts.fact: Biometric Update, citing the National Directorate of Civil Identification (DNIC), reports 856,101 national ID cards issued between January and June 2026, with biometric data collected for issuance.
